study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Martin et al., Drug and Alcohol Dependence Reports, 2025
study_identification_part.si4_title: Sex differences in normative modeling of cortical thickness in cannabis use disorder

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Assess sex differences in normative cortical thickness z-scores in adults with cannabis use disorder (CUD), and test associations between z-scores and behavioral measures (craving, cannabis-related problems, impulsivity).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Both sexes showed normative-average cortical thickness overall; females exhibited higher cortical thickness z-scores than males in several regions; three sexually dimorphic regions’ z-scores related to cannabis-related problems.
